refnamediv.refpurpose: Export a socket into a stream that encapsulates a socket

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
resourcefalsesocket_export_stream Socketsocket
Exports a Socket into a stream that encapsulates the socket, so that the stream functions, such as fread and fwrite, can be used on it. Calling the function again for the same socket returns the same stream.
The Socket and the stream share the same file descriptor. Closing the stream closes the descriptor, and the Socket can no longer be used. The descriptor is released when both the Socket and the stream are gone.
